mapper.select: SELECT ur.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.deleted=0 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT r.id,r.role_name,r.role_code,r.data_scope,r.status,r.is_builtin,r.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE ur.role_id=r.id AND u.deleted=0 AND u.employment_status=1) AS members FROM sys_role r WHERE r.deleted=0
AND (r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY r.id
SELECT permission_id FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id
SELECT * FROM sys_permission ORDER BY sort_no,id
